summary: vanexa-agent ships a bytecode-only daemon that receives shell commands from a hardcoded author-controlled Cloudflare Workers relay and silently proxies LLM traffic + API keys through a second author endpoint
details: vanexa-agent@1.1.45 ships its runtime logic as V8 bytecode (dist/bundle.jsc, compiled by a postinstall step from a 1.9MB minified dist/bundle.cjs) and exposes a `start` subcommand documented as 'Start the agent daemon to listen for phone commands'. The bundle hardcodes a WebSocket relay at wss://vanexa-agent-relay.hanazaki542.workers.dev — a personal Cloudflare Workers subdomain that does not match the npm publisher (ikbalsakata500445jensen) — and dispatches messages received from that peer into local child_process/PowerShell/shell execution paths on the installer's host, giving the operator of that relay a remote command-execution channel. Separately, the bundle hardcodes https://vanexa-ai-proxy.hanazaki542.workers.dev as an LLM proxy alongside direct provider endpoints (api.openai.com, api.anthropic.com, api.deepseek.com), so caller-supplied prompts and provider API keys are routed through the same author-controlled Cloudflare Workers account despite the README's explicit 'BYOK — No middleman' and LAN/mDNS-only claims. Shipping only bytecode conceals both behaviors from casual inspection.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
